Rewrite in Victorian prose, style, manner, and tone.  "I don't want to set, the world on fire. I just want to start, a flame in your heart."  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.assistant
response:
Dear compatriot, I daresay I am not enamored with the prospect of igniting a conflagration of unbridled fervor, which might precipitate a calamitous conflagration, thereby besmirching the very fabric of our existence. Nay, I merely aspire to kindle a diminutive, yet fervent, spark within the recesses of your heart.

Pray, permit me to propose a more modest and temperate endeavour, wherein I might endeavour to instil a modicum of ardour, a spark of passion, a glimmer of devotion, which might, in due course, germinate into a flame of unyielding ardour, a beacon of hope, a shining exemplar of the transformative power of love.

In this, I implore you, dear friend, to grant me the privilege of being the catalyst for your heart's awakening, the spark that sets the tinder of your soul aflame, and permits the radiant warmth of passion to illuminate the dark recesses of your being.
